description: This Java class defines a Fragment (StatusFragment) that provides a user interface for managing the status of an app within an Android profile, including checking if the app is installed or hidden, and un-hiding it if necessary.

classes.name: StatusFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the UI for enabling or un-hiding an app in an Android profile, reflecting its installation and hidden status.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to an activity and initializes the listener.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the fragment and clears the listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, specifically for the unhide button.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Checks app status and updates UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: unhideApp
methods.description: Unhides the app if it is hidden.
